title: keryx review conform: check a PR, a review report or code against a reference document, clause by clause, with Jev

AC4.note: conform-state.ts computeReportConformFacts: report sections and order, severity/evidence counts, anchorCounts via classifyFindingAnchor; conform-state.test.ts; hunk state via buildReviewScope

AC1.note: src/review/conform-clauses.ts: extractReferenceClauses(docText) — pure/sync, no model call; clause_id = <nearest-heading-slug>-<index>. Pinned for an invented fixture (src/review/fixtures/conform/invented-doctrine.md) in conform-clauses.test.ts (12 tests).

AC2.note: conform-clauses.ts: explicit [state:pr|report|hunk]/[not-checkable: reason] markers parsed with no model call; buildClauseTagQuestions/applyClauseTags/clauseTagFromChoice for the Jev-choice fallback; conform-tag-cache.ts caches by hashConformDocContent (sha256), keyed per doc path, merges on write. conform-clauses.test.ts + conform-tag-cache.test.ts (16 tests).

AC3.note: conform-state.ts: parsePrBodySections/computePrConformFacts/prClauseFacts use buildReviewScope(diff) for hand-written line counts (mechanical bulk excluded via scope.ts drop reasons) and section presence/emptiness; conform-pr-port.ts (createGhConformPrPort/createFixtureConformPrPort, gh pr view+diff, live/fixture split). conform-state.test.ts + conform-pr-port.test.ts (16 tests); live-verified against real PRs #709/#708/#689 (journal).

AC5.note: conform-jev.ts: batchConformItems groups same-kind clauses sharing state under CONFORM_TOKEN_BUDGET=64k (estimateTokens), never truncating; conform-state.ts's *ClauseFacts functions place deterministic facts above the redacted state text; a decisive fact (e.g. a stated size budget) is reported alongside Jev's own answer, never in place of it. conform-jev.test.ts (7 tests, incl. a 10-clause oversized batch that splits).

AC6.note: keryx review conform wired in src/commands/review.ts (runConform); renderConformMarkdown/conformResultToJson in conform-report.ts print id/kind/checkable-or-not(+reason)/deterministic evidence/probability per clause; not-checkable always listed; a checkable clause whose kind has no target this run reads not-evaluated (tracked per-clause via a Set, not per-kind). review-conform-cli.test.ts AC6 blocks (--pr and --report, 7 tests) + conform-report.test.ts (11 tests).

AC7.note: explainConformVerdicts (review.ts) sends every clause scored below --threshold (default 0.5, configurable, validated 0..1) to resolveConformExplainModel's resolution of the review routing category (session model when unset, via resolveCategoryDetailed); output labelled ADVISORY, nothing written to findings.json or a PR (no write path exists). review-conform-cli.test.ts (--explain, --threshold tests); live-verified: session-default failed closed silently on rate-limit, and an explicit trusted routing produced 3 real advisory explanations (journal).

AC8.note: src/tui/conform-inspector.ts (new file, not editing ci-triage-*): setup tab lists recent docs (recents remembered via conform-report.ts's withRecentDoc, persisted at .metaproject/data/review-conform/recent-docs.json) then the three targets (PR/report/diff); clauses tab groups by kind with status; detail tab shows evidence+explanation. src/tui/conform-source.ts (production loader/runner, mirrors ci-triage-source.ts). Wired into tui-shell.ts (/conform) and agent-commands.ts. conform-inspector.test.ts: 10 tests, real OpenTUI renderer, 0 skips.

AC9.note: readConformEnabled (conform-report.ts) reads review.jev.conform from .metaproject/tasks.config.json, default false, mirrors readCiTriageEnabled's pattern exactly; runConform checks opt-in then OPENROUTER_API_KEY credential BEFORE reading the reference doc or the target, refuses with no network call; every state text passes through redactSensitiveText. review-conform-cli.test.ts AC9 block (2 tests proving the ref path is never even opened when refused) + conform-report.test.ts opt-in gate tests (4 tests).

AC10.note: src/review/fixtures/conform/invented-doctrine.md and src/commands/fixtures/conform/invented-ref.md (+ report-package fixtures) are entirely invented for this repository, in a different domain and structure from the operator's example (a data-pipeline contribution policy: numbered rules mixed across workflow-stage headings covering opening a change, a change-size limit, a per-pass review record, code/test hunks, and a sign-off condition); no wording copied. Every conform-*.test.ts file and review-conform-cli.test.ts uses only invented text.

AC11.note: Live check run against the operator's real private reference document and real merged PRs/review package of MrCipherSmith/keryx from a scratch project dir (review.jev.conform enabled only there); env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY so the saved openrouterKey resolved. Full per-clause-id verdicts, cost and an honest usefulness assessment recorded in the flow journal (entry 2026-09-25T10:03:47.000Z) — no document text, no clause text, no file path. Found and fixed a real vendor API mismatch (choice-question criteria: array vs record) live.

AC12.note: keryx review conform in dispatch (review.ts command switch), HELP_GROUPS (/conform slash entry, Managed work group), AGENT_SLASH_COMMANDS (agent-commands.ts), and the CLI reference (docs/docs/cli-reference.md: usage line, subcommand table row, review conform section) all in English; cli-reference-coverage.test.ts, help-groups.test.ts, commands-by-task.test.ts, agent-commands.test.ts all pass. gh pr view 711: state=MERGED, statusCheckRollup {SUCCESS,SKIPPED} only; keryx health run: PASS, project score 94, no gate conditions triggered.
